Getting started.Do I need Librescoot firmware to use the: No. The app can control an unu Scooter Pro running stock firmware. A scooter running Librescoot exposes additional features such as navigation, keycards, power settings, alarms, and Bluetooth updates.
Getting started.Can several phones use one scooter?: Yes. Up to eight devices can be paired with the scooter, but only one can control it at a time. On Librescoot 1.3.0 or newer, you can clear all Bluetooth bonds from the scooter Dashboard menu. Keep a keycard available in case pairing needs to be restored.

Connection and pairing.Why can't the app find my scooter?: Stand next to the scooter and make sure it is switched on, Bluetooth is enabled, and no other phone is connected. A Bluetooth symbol on the dashboard usually means another device already has the active connection.
Connection and pairing.Why did a pairing request appear before: Some phones show an early pairing request before the scooter displays its code. Dismiss that request and continue in the app. Accept the request that appears when the code is visible on the scooter.
Connection and pairing.What should I do if reconnecting keeps f: Close other scooter apps, toggle Bluetooth, and try again near the scooter. Check that the scooter still unlocks with a keycard. If it does not, the problem may be with the scooter rather than the phone.

Librescoot.What is Librescoot?: Librescoot is an independent, open-source operating system for the unu Scooter Pro. It replaces discontinued cloud-dependent services with local control, navigation, updates, and community-maintained features.
Librescoot.Does this app install Librescoot?: No. Use the [Librescoot Installer](https://downloads.librescoot.org/) to install Librescoot. After installation, this app can manage supported settings and install compatible firmware updates over Bluetooth.
Librescoot.Where can I get help?: Start with the [handbook](https://librescoot.org/handbook/) and [troubleshooting guide](https://librescoot.org/handbook/troubleshooting.html). For individual help, ask in the [Librescoot Discord](https://discord.gg/BmY2P2T9j3). Use [GitHub issues](https://github.com/librescoot/mobile-app/issues) for reproducible app bugs and concrete feature requests.

About the app.Who makes this app?: Freal created the original app as stasis for unu. Librescoot contributors maintain this community fork for unu Scooter Pro riders. It is not an official app from the scooter manufacturer or brand owner.
About the app.What data leaves my phone?: Scooter control happens directly over Bluetooth. Optional online features may request maps, address lookup, notifications, or firmware information. App diagnostics are shared only when you start a report.
About the app.How can I contribute?: Source code and issue tracking are available on GitHub. Contributions to code, translations, documentation, testing, and design are welcome.
